conventions.pose_in: translation + rotation_axis (normalised on read) + rotation_angle_degrees (the contract's RigidTransform)
conventions.pose_out: translation + rotation (3x3 row-major, 9 floats): compare matrices, never axis-angle
conventions.twist: [vx vy vz wx wy wz]: velocity of the occurrence ORIGIN and rotation vector (rad); rows/columns per member, grabbed first
conventions.metric: <a,b> = sum (s_i a_i)(s_i b_i), s = [1,1,1,L,L,L] per member, times follower_weight for non-grabbed members
